A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TABLET study and contain complete, readable main text, references, and appendices. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support a reliable comparison throughout.

before.justification: v1 reports original fine-tuning experiments, benchmark evaluations, and ablations in Section 5, with additional experimental results in Appendix 8.

after.justification: v2 retains the original fine-tuning experiments, ablations, and supplementary model evaluations reported in Tables 2–4 and 9–12.

M1.justification: Dataset reconstruction, image/HTML pairing, cell highlighting, instruction construction, and the Qwen2.5-VL fine-tuning procedure remain unchanged in Sections 3–4 and Appendix 8.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same TABLET tasks and source datasets, held-in and held-out benchmarks, and original/synthetic table-image scenarios. No training or evaluation coverage changes.

E2.justification: The Qwen2.5-VL zero/one-shot and MMTab-trained comparators remain identical. Appendix 8.4 retains the same Table-LLaVA, DocOwl2, InternVL3, Gemma-3, and Qwen model comparisons.

E3.justification: Training subsets, held-out exclusions, data splits, evaluation metrics, model configurations, and three-epoch training settings are unchanged in Sections 4–5 and Appendices 7–8.

E4.justification: The original-versus-synthetic image comparisons, dataset-size analysis, removal of table-interpretation tasks, and performance-degradation analysis are retained without revision.

E5.justification: Tables 3–4 retain bootstrap-resampling significance comparisons at p < 0.05. Figure 4 retains the same instruction-length mean and standard-deviation reporting; no seed or repeated-run information changes.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout, including main Tables 2–4 and appendix Tables 9–12. No result entries are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: Appendix 8.2 retains identical definitions of score differences, normalized percentage changes, and the metric-family-averaged degradation score. No mathematical reasoning or formal results change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about TABLET's scale, visual fidelity, extensibility, benchmark performance, robustness, and transfer to unseen tasks.

C2.justification: Interpretations of visual robustness and task transfer are unchanged. Section 9 retains the same limitations concerning missing visualizations, incomplete task ablations, potential contamination, and fine-tuning a single model.

D1.justification: Footnote 1 changes resources from 'will be publicly available' to 'are available' and supplies a TABLET repository address. Implementation and compute details remain unchanged; Appendix 8 still retains future-release wording for the code.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and positioning relative to MMTab and other table-understanding resources are unchanged. Related-work text crossing a page boundary is reflowed, not added.

P1.justification: The author block changes from two affiliation-based groups to one author list with numbered affiliations, and the availability sentence is revised. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The revised author block and footnote produce limited text-position and page-break changes across pages 1–5. Figures and tables remain unchanged; rendered pages 6–29 are identical.

improvement.justification: Replacing the future-release promise with a concrete repository address makes resource-access information more useful. This is a limited documentation improvement: scientific evidence is unchanged, Appendix 8 retains inconsistent future-release wording, and repository contents cannot be established from the PDFs.
